subject: Urgent: Pipeline blockage causing p95/p99 spike for NovaTech
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@novatech.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: sre@novatech.ai
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden p95/p99 jump since 08:45 UTC — investigating

Hi Sergio,

We started seeing a sharp jump in generation latency around 08:45 UTC this morning. Our p95 has gone from ~450ms to ~1.8s and p99 to ~5.6s for the hosted API calls to the Redwood endpoint used by our chat service. Error rate also nudged up to ~0.8% (mostly 503s/timeouts). This is impacting user sessions — our CS team is reporting a 25% increase in support tickets.

We confirmed there wasn't any change on our side (no deploys, traffic constant). Can you triage? We can provide logs and a short session of traffic replay if helpful.

Samir
Platform Lead, NovaTech

Attachments: none (we can send logs on request)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@novatech.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 09:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump since 08:45 UTC — investigating

Thanks Samir — I see the alert. We're pulling telemetry now. Can you send a short span of example request IDs (X-Request-Id) for a few affected calls? That will help us look up end-to-end traces.

Marissa (on infra) is on standby and Neha will check rate/usage patterns. I will update within 30 minutes with initial findings.

— Sergio

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

On Sat, Sep 30, 2028 at 9:18 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Samir — I see the alert. We're pulling telemetry now. Can you send a short span of example request IDs...

Got a first pass: queue depth for the hosted-api pool for the eu-west and us-east shards spiked starting 08:44:50 UTC. Batching timers increased (avg batch wait +120ms) and we saw a ~30% increase in KV-cache miss rate for sequences >512 tokens which caused longer kernel runs. Autoscaler did not add capacity fast enough because of a transient throttling on the pool controller (internal rate limiter kicked in at 08:46:05 UTC).

Preliminary impact numbers: p95 uplift ~1.3-1.8s, p99 ~4.8-6.2s, 503s clustered when queue depth exceeded the soft cap and requests hit fallback path.

I'm attaching a zipped telemetry snapshot. Will prepare a short mitigation list now.

— Marissa
Sr. SRE, Serving Runtime

Attachments: telemetry-snapshot-20280930.zip

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 10:05:27 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: Pipeline blockage causing p95/p99 spike for NovaTech

Folks — elevating to leadership + ops. Customer is seeing production user impact. Key facts: spike began ~08:45 UTC, queue depth surge, autoscaler throttle, KV miss increase, batching wait popped.

Immediate asks:
- Jonas: please propose a short rollback or config flip (batch timer, pool controller rate-limit override) we can do without a model redeploy.
- Grace: estimate customer-facing ETA and messaging cadence for Novatech.
- Marissa/Neha: mitigation steps and any hotfix scripts.

I'll loop in Sales/CS execs after we have a concrete ETA.

— Sergio

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novatech.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 10:22:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: Pipeline blockage causing p95/p99 spike for NovaTech

On Sat, Sep 30, 2028 at 10:05 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — elevating to leadership + ops. Customer is seeing production user impact.

Short plan (safe, reversible):
1) Disable adaptive batch timer for the affected pools (us-east + eu-west) — revert to fixed small batch window (5ms) to reduce head-of-line wait. Risk: slight throughput drop — acceptable for short window.
2) Temporarily increase pool soft cap by +20% and bump max workers by 2 nodes to soak backlog.
3) Override pool controller rate limiter for NovaTech route for 30 minutes to allow autoscaler to spin up.
4) If latency not back to baseline in 20m, failover a percentage (10%) of requests to a smaller quantized model variant with explicit client opt-in and inform customer.

Attached a mutual action plan doc and the telemetry snapshot Marissa uploaded. I'll run the config flips and monitor.

ETA: first changes in 10m, measurable delta expected in 12-18m.

— Jonas
Principal Infra Engineer

Attachments: nova-multi-action-plan-v1.docx

From: Samir Patel <samir@novatech.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Pipeline blockage causing p95/p99 spike for NovaTech — resolved

Team,

Thanks — the changes helped. We saw p95 return to ~520ms and p99 back to ~1.1s after the fixed-window batch config and the soft-cap bump. The temporary routing to the quantized model (10% traffic) was seamless and reduced error spikes. Support tickets dropped back to baseline by late afternoon.

Two asks before we close:
- Can Redwood add an automated alert when pool controller rate-limiter trips (we missed that signal)?
- Let's run a short postmortem with NovaTech next week to agree on a long-term mitigation (request: durable autoscaler override + playbook).

Samir
Platform Lead, NovaTech
